summary: NEXOVEO is an interactive web platform designed to make Earth system trends easier to explore and understand. It brings selected NASA Earth observation and climate resources into a visual experience centered on an interactive 3D globe. Users can examine environmental variables by geographic area and time, compare regional patterns, and explore changes through maps, charts, and visual indicators. By connecting scientific data with geographic context, NEXOVEO helps users investigate what is changing, where those changes are occurring, and how environmental patterns differ across regions. The project addresses the challenge by making complex Earth science information more accessible, encouraging data-driven exploration, and supporting a clearer understanding of the interconnected processes that shape our planet.
details:
NEXOVEO is a web-based Earth observation and climate trend exploration platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

The platform provides an interactive 3D globe that connects geographic visualization with Earth science information. It is designed to help users explore environmental variables, investigate changes across different locations and time periods, and understand how interconnected Earth system processes influence our planet.

Through interactive maps, data layers, charts, and visual indicators, NEXOVEO organizes complex scientific information into an accessible and intuitive experience. Its purpose is to help identify what is changing, where changes are occurring, and how environmental patterns differ across regions.

The project focuses on scientific accessibility, data visualization, geographic context, and transparency. It aims to bridge the gap between complex Earth observation datasets and the people who need to interpret them.

Our team considered usability, data reliability, geographic coverage, temporal variation, source identification, and the limitations of scientific datasets.
